verdict.rationale: Proa documents several of its own mechanisms for keeping apps fast and maintainable. Maintainability comes from compile-time-checked props and template validation, editor rename and go-to-definition, a formatter that verifies rendered output is preserved, and generator-maintained route registration with a route table. Speed comes from a `--deny warnings` lint that catches performance problems, small island JS with a ~1.3 KB runtime, out-of-order Suspense streaming, and reproducible benchmarks. missing for 10: evidence about scaling to large teams and codebases (build times, modularity, multi-team structure), and independent or hands-on corroboration of performance beyond the vendor's own benchmark repo.
